description.zh: 座席姓名
description.en: The agent name.

description.zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
description.en: The city associated with the customer's number. Leave empty to query all cities. Example: Chengdu. This parameter must be URL-encoded.

description.zh: 外显号码；外显的号码
description.en: The caller ID number.

description.zh: 座席工号，3-10位数字
description.en: The agent ID, which must be a 3- to 10-digit number.
The customer's phone number. Example: `18012345678`.

description.zh: 客户侧真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，客户侧的真实外显号码为虚拟号
description.en: The number displayed to the customer. In number substitution scenarios, such as AXB, this is the virtual number.

description.zh: 是否呼叫降级；0-否, 1-是
description.en: Specifies whether the call was downgraded. Valid values: `0` (No) and `1` (Yes).

description.zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
description.en: The end of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The query range cannot span a calendar month. Default: the last day of the current month.

description.zh: 呼叫中心 id
description.en: The call center ID.

description.zh: 座席所属外呼组 单个外呼组号2-20位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持10个。不支持模糊匹配。
description.en: The agent's outbound group ID. You can specify up to 10 comma-separated IDs, each 2 to 20 characters long. Fuzzy matching is not supported.

description.zh: 真人接听；取值说明：1-是、0-否
description.en: Specifies whether the call was answered by a human. Valid values: 1 (Yes) and 0 (No).

description.zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return. Value range: 1–1000. Default: 10.

description.zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
description.en: The province associated with the customer's number. Leave empty to query all provinces. Example: Sichuan. This parameter must be URL-encoded.

description.zh: 查询请求唯一id对应的记录信息，默认查询当前月，如requestUniqueId不属于当前月，查询时请传递查询参数 查询开始时间(startTime)
description.en: The unique request ID. By default, the system queries records for the current month. If the record associated with this ID is not from the current month, you must also specify the `StartTime` parameter.

description.zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The pagination offset. Valid values: ≥ 0. Default: 0.

description.zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
description.en: The start of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The query range cannot span a calendar month. Default: the first day of the current month.

description.zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明：40:预测外呼, 客户未接听； 41:预测外呼, 客户接听； 42: 预测外呼,已呼叫； 43: 预测外呼, 双方接听
description.en: The call result. Valid values: 40 (Predictive call, customer did not answer), 41 (Predictive call, customer answered), 42 (Predictive call, initiated), 43 (Predictive call, both parties answered).

description.zh: 批次id
description.en: The batch ID.

description.zh: 外呼任务id
description.en: The outbound task ID.

description.zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
description.en: Specifies how the time range defined by `StartTime` and `EndTime` is applied. This parameter takes effect only when `StartTime` and `EndTime` are specified. Valid values: 1 (filters by call start time) and 2 (filters by call end time). Default value: 1.

description.zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
description.en: If this parameter is specified, other filter parameters are ignored and only the record associated with this unique call ID is queried.

description.zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
description.en: The value of the user-defined field to use for filtering. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify `UserFieldkey`. This allows you to query based on a single custom field, and fuzzy matching is not supported. The query condition is constructed as `{"userFieldkey":"userFieldValue"}`. This parameter must be URL-encoded.

description.zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
description.en: The key of the user-defined field to use for filtering. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify `UserFieldValue`. This allows you to query based on a single custom field, and fuzzy matching is not supported. The query condition is constructed as `{"userFieldkey":"userFieldValue"}`. This parameter must be URL-encoded.
